what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Croatia, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's last figure for people displaced by conflict and violence is 2059, for 2011.
For 2011, UNHCR's file shows no figure above zero, which may mean none or not reported.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Croatia in these years, so it does not say why people were displaced.
IDMC's disaster records for Croatia list wildfires.

when.text: IDMC's figure stayed between 2059 and 2400 from 2009 to 2011.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2011.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 27 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Croatia.
